annotations.title: Restore a post from the Bin

description: Bring a deleted post back from the Bin. Only posts in the Bin, for 30 days after they were deleted (the Bin in the app shows the last 5). A scheduled post whose time has passed, or is under 2 minutes away, comes back as a draft, so it never goes out on its own: ask the user for a new time, then use sprkly_update_scheduled_post. A posted post comes back as posted (it only shows again), a failed post stays failed, and a draft stays a draft. Only when the user asks.

post_id.description: The id of the post in the Bin.
